newsitem.title: USA: Deprenyl drug available in added dosages.
newsitem.headline: Deprenyl drug available in added dosages.

text.p: Deprenyl Animal Health Inc said Thursday that Canada's Health Protection Branch, Bureau of Veterinary Drugs, has approved the 10 and 30 milligram dosages of the company's Aniprylr.
The drug is indicated for treating canine Cushing's disease, a degenerative condition that affects older dogs. The full range of Aniprylr dosages now is two, five, 10, 15 and 30 milligrams.
Deprenyl also said it filed with Canada's Health Protection Branch, Bureau of Veterinary Drugs, for approval to sell Aniprylr to treat cognitive dysfunction.
